name: EIDSS v7
what_it_is: An open-source multi-domain epidemiological surveillance platform for public health and veterinary authorities to record, investigate, and report on human disease cases, animal health events, laboratory results, vector surveillance, and outbreaks. Built on ASP.NET Core with SQL Server and a Blazor/Razor frontend.
constraints: Three connection strings required; no defaults
JWT Secret must be set explicitly with zero clock-skew
AllowedHosts defaults to wildcard; must override for production
PIN integration requires live endpoint or mock flag
README is blank placeholder; no install instructions
